name: io.github.iowarp/chronolog-mcp
title: CLIO Chronolog
description: ChronoLog MCP server implementation using Model Context Protocol

tools.name: start_chronolog
tools.description: Connect to ChronoLog, create a chronicle, and acquire a story handle.

tools.name: record_interaction
tools.description: Log a user message and LLM response to the active ChronoLog story.

tools.name: stop_chronolog
tools.description: Release the story handle and disconnect from ChronoLog.

tools.name: retrieve_interaction
tools.description: Retrieve logged records from a chronicle and story, with optional time filtering.

prompts.name: logging_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for querying and analyzing ChronoLog entries.
